name: manual_b8f159
claim: Orama pull request 379 changes only the post-merge review sweep workflow and does not change guard-sync files. That workflow is outside the guard-sync manifest, so syncing guard scripts must not copy it into Perpetua-Tools. A clean Perpetua-Tools tree at origin/main is already byte-identical to that pull request for every manifest path, and sync-attribution-guard-scripts.sh from that tree exits without edits. A local checkout that is behind origin/main can report lag even when the published main tree matches; do not treat that lag as a reason to edit guard scripts on a memory branch.

decisions.notes: check-guard-sync-divergence.sh against the pull request head passed for a worktree created from origin/main, and the following sync wrote no files. The workspace scan also passed. The live checkout that is behind origin/main is a different tree and was not the sync target.
